queer_characters.name: Marsha P. Johnson
queer_characters.notes: Real historical trans woman of color and activist, key figure in the Stonewall uprising and co-founder of STAR; the film centers on the investigation into her suspicious 1992 death.

queer_characters.name: Sylvia Rivera
queer_characters.notes: Real historical trans woman activist and co-founder of STAR alongside Johnson, portrayed as a prominent liberation figure.

queer_characters.name: Victoria Cruz
queer_characters.notes: Trans activist and investigator who leads the documentary's present-day inquiry into Johnson's death.

contributor_notes: Documentary chronicling real historical trans activists Marsha P. Johnson and Sylvia Rivera. Note the controversy raised in the source text: filmmaker Tourmaline alleged director David France appropriated her research; France denied it and investigations found no supporting evidence, but it raised questions about a non-transgender filmmaker telling this story — a maintainer may want to reflect this in the queer_creators/own-voices tagging. No source text on director's identity, so no queer_creators entries added. Trigger warnings for historical erasure and police negligence noted in source text but no matching enum values available.
